who will unlock this book and breathe life back into these hallowed pages?
will they understand the dreams that flowed forth from my heart, imbuing them with meaning, illuminating the path ahead? or will they merely read of lives lived elsewhere, separate from their own, unable to grasp the connections that bind us all together – our hearts beating as one, souls entwined by some unseen force?
